init.title: Thermostat
init.description: The fireplace's own thermostat measures the room with its handset. If you pick a temperature sensor here, Home Assistant regulates the flame on that sensor instead. It never ignites the fireplace: with the room warm enough it turns the flame down to the pilot, and back up when heat is needed.

shutting_down.message: The fireplace is still shutting down. Try again in a moment.

no_receiver.message: The WiFi module has no connection to the receiver in the fireplace.

receiver_lost.title: {name}: no connection to the fireplace
receiver_lost.description: The WiFi module of {name} answers, but it has lost its radio link to the receiver in the fireplace (the app shows this as F43). Commands do not reach the fireplace until the link is back. Check the receiver's power supply or batteries. Operating the fireplace with its handset, or switching its power off and on, usually restores the link.
